name: Button
description: Button is a polymorphic action component built on Box. It supports variants, intents, and sizes, with optional icons on either side. Padding and height adjust automatically per size, and when no children are provided it renders as a square icon-only button.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant of the button (e.g. solid, outline, ghost)

props.name: intent
props.description: Semantic intent for coloring (e.g. primary, success, danger, neutral)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and applies disabled styling

props.name: size
props.description: Button size controlling height, padding, and font size

props.name: iconName
props.description: Optional icon name to render inside the button

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Position of the icon relative to text (e.g. left or right)
